notes: «خالد هو ابن الحارث» is an editor's gloss, left out. Umm Sulaym speaks in the story, but the saying relayed is the Prophet's visit, reported by Anas, so she stays out (rule 6). «وحدثتني ابنتي أمينة» is Anas's own account of his daughter, not a route of the Prophet's saying, not stored. The closing «حدثنا ابن أبي مريم ... عن النبي» is a second isnad for the same saying, so it is a group.
